caption: The drawing is done in grayscale and features a single large decorative goblet or cup at the center, rendered with detailed shading and fine lines. The surface of the cup is adorned with floral and leafy patterns, primarily concentrated around the upper and lower sections. In the central area of the cup, there is an oval medallion containing a standing female figure holding an object, with a church or castle-like building in the background and landscape elements at her feet. The rim of the cup has inscriptions that read "Rufftown" and "A 1583." Above the cup, there are two smaller oval illustrations: the one on the left shows a woman standing outside a building, holding a staff or tall object, while a child or small figure stands beside her; the one on the right depicts a woman holding a cross, standing next to a church or building, with a halo or radiant light around her head. All elements are rendered in delicate pencil, with variations in shading used to convey depth and texture. The composition of the drawing is centered on the goblet, with the two smaller ovals positioned symmetrically in the upper corners. The artist's signature, "H. Reina," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Beaker
